question: Does pinning the exact R123 source-M32 strategy remove R122b's B-dependent arithmetic while retaining its near-natural batched throughput?

strategy.source: R123 natural M=32, identical SHA across all six R124 discoveries

screen.procedure: Run one same-build no-override control, health-check, then one fresh-process source-M32 override candidate.

gates.correctness: For both shapes: one row-0 class, exact versus sequential M4 at every B, B32 permutation exact, and B16 repeat exact.
gates.latency: At B=1,8,32,64 for both shapes, candidate/control geometric mean <=1.15 and no point >1.50x.
gates.on_pass: Expand the same composition to all six production shapes, then design a production non-developer implementation. Do not launch a server yet.
gates.on_failure: Close this composition and proceed to a custom fused batched kernel; do not tune other catalog strategies.
gates.health: Stop on any new Xe fault, reset, timeout, hang, coredump, or device loss.
